verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents meeting capture across Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Its bot can be invited ad hoc or set to auto-join calendar meetings to record, which gives per-meeting control over what gets recorded, and Enterprise Private Storage lets data be stored at a preferred location. Reliability is only vendor-claimed and recording-selection controls are thinly described. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of capture reliability across all three platforms, detailed docs on per-meeting recording rules and Teams/Zoom-specific behavior.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.
Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.
Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.
